Muscular dystrophy with defining intellectual disability and developmental delay; cardiomyopathy and respiratory complications are occasional (<30%).
Inherited neurodegeneration; macular degeneration annotated at 80-99%. Recurrent respiratory infections do not establish intrinsic lung damage or immunodeficiency.
Inherited dissection of cervical arteries; stroke is a separately diagnosed complication rather than universal intrinsic neurologic involvement.
Congenital small-bowel atresia and hypoplasia; the local vascular developmental mechanism does not establish an additional vascular disease.
Neurologic and renal tissues are major direct targets across heavy-metal toxicities. Other organ injury varies by metal; gastrointestinal symptoms alone do not establish damage.
Cardiac glycoside toxicity directly disrupts cardiac conduction and rhythm; nausea and visual disturbances alone do not establish additional organ damage.
Defined by developmental delay, intellectual disability and microcephaly; ocular malformations and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism are variable without evidence of ≥30% prevalence.
Combined immunodeficiency defines the umbrella; no additional organ damage is established as common across its heterogeneous subtypes.
Bacterial infection of the skin; postinfectious renal disease is a separate, uncommon complication.
Inherited sandal-gap configuration is a structural anomaly of the toes; no additional organ involvement is described.
Congenital absence or hypoplasia of central hand rays, phalanges and metacarpals; explicitly nonsyndromic.
Umbrella defined by disease of the epidermis; additional organs affected in particular subtypes do not apply across the group.
Spastic paraplegia from GM2 synthase deficiency, a ganglioside biosynthesis defect; scoliosis in 10/15 and muscle atrophy in 11/18. Cataracts and urinary abnormalities <30%.
Severe decompensated hypothyroidism with defining encephalopathy or coma; generalized physiologic slowing alone does not establish additional organ damage.
GnRH deficiency and olfactory developmental dysfunction define ANOS1-related Kallmann syndrome; unilateral renal agenesis occurs in approximately 30%.
Defined by enlargement of renal parenchyma in one or both kidneys.
Glycosylation disorder with seizures and severe developmental impairment in 3/3; renal cortical cysts in 1/3. Specific skin lesions and optic atrophy annotated <30%.
Tetralogy of Fallot is defining congenital cardiac disease; hypertelorism alone does not establish ocular dysfunction or additional skeletal disease.
Ependymal tumor arising in the supratentorial brain.
Developmental abnormality of intestinal enteric ganglia directly affects peripheral neural tissue and intestinal motility.
Craniosynostosis and pectoral/limb hypoplasia define the syndrome; strabismus occurs in 30-79%. Minor oral/nail morphology does not establish functional damage.
Defining cardiac, cutaneous and neurodevelopmental disease; pectus excavatum in 3/3, scoliosis in 2/3 and reduced bone density in 1/3 support skeletal involvement.
Immune-mediated cutaneous lupus with dermal inflammatory infiltrates; systemic lupus organ involvement is not characteristic of this subtype.
PRC2-related overgrowth syndromes combine intellectual developmental impairment with skeletal overgrowth and advanced bone maturation; no common visceral damage established.
